name: Margarita
source:
An amateur astronomer and very lazy, sometimes she doesn't mind sleeping more.
Margarita is the person who is always positive.
She is a student of the famous - Virgilia Seiner.
According to the "Longevity" system - Margarita is a top-ranking mtsyr
